subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw support `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as the hook-level model override for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it converts a previously ignored passthrough key into an upgrade-visible provider/model routing contract.

options.title: Accept the hook config key
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as supported config and land this PR once required checks stay green.

options.title: Choose a different config surface
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers decide whether slug model selection should live somewhere else.

options.title: Reject hook-level support
options.body: Close this PR and route broader slug-model policy to the adjacent product issue.

recommendation.title: Accept the hook config key
recommendation.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as supported config and land this PR once required checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across both session-memory handler behavior and slug-generator model behavior.
